description: Reference vectors for the capabilities matching rule (docs/capabilities.md). Each case gives candidate circuits (partial descriptors: only id, aliases, system, status and capabilities, which are all Match reads), a request, and the expected ids in rank order; expectError means the request is malformed. An implementation passes if, for every case, its result equals expect exactly, order included.

cases.name: baseline
cases.description: A circuit declaring the requested function matches.

cases.name: system-filter
cases.description: Rule 1: system must be in proofSystems when given.

cases.name: system-filter-empty-means-any
cases.description: Rule 1: an empty or absent proofSystems filter matches every system.

cases.name: id-filter
cases.description: Rule 1: id must be in circuitIds when given.

cases.name: id-filter-alias
cases.description: Rule 1: an alias of the entry satisfies circuitIds.

cases.name: id-filter-no-hit
cases.description: Rule 1: nothing listed in circuitIds exists, so nothing matches.

cases.name: system-and-id-filters-both-apply
cases.description: Rule 1: both filters must pass.

cases.name: revoked-never-matches
cases.description: Rule 2: revoked entries never match.

cases.name: revoked-alone
cases.description: Rule 2: revoked is the only candidate, result is empty.

cases.name: deprecated-ranks-below-active
cases.description: Rule 2: a deprecated entry matches but ranks below an active one even when its id sorts first.

cases.name: deprecated-alone-matches
cases.description: Rule 2: a deprecated entry is still usable when nothing better matches.

cases.name: no-capabilities-not-matchable
cases.description: Rule 3: an entry without capabilities cannot be matched.

cases.name: presentation-mismatch
cases.description: Rule 3: capabilities.presentation must equal the request's.

cases.name: credential-format-mismatch
cases.description: Rule 3: credential.format must equal the request's.

cases.name: credential-type-mismatch
cases.description: Rule 3: credential.type must equal the request's.

cases.name: function-not-declared
cases.description: Rule 4: a requested function the circuit does not declare.

cases.name: unlisted-param
cases.description: Rule 4: a param not listed for the function is unsupported.

cases.name: enum-match
cases.description: Rule 4: a value inside the enum satisfies the constraint.

cases.name: enum-miss
cases.description: Rule 4: a value outside the enum fails the constraint.

cases.name: enum-non-string-value
cases.description: Rule 4: an enum constraint only accepts a string value.

cases.name: full-date-valid
cases.description: Rule 4: type full-date accepts a YYYY-MM-DD date.

cases.name: full-date-invalid
cases.description: Rule 4: type full-date rejects a non-date value.

cases.name: full-date-not-a-string
cases.description: Rule 4: type full-date rejects a non-string value.

cases.name: integer-and-string-types
cases.description: Rule 4: type integer and string constraints.

cases.name: integer-rejects-fraction
cases.description: Rule 4: type integer rejects 1.5.

cases.name: string-type-rejects-number
cases.description: Rule 4: type string rejects a non-string value.

cases.name: param-omitted-is-fine
cases.description: Rule 4: listed params may be left out of a request item.

cases.name: max-at-limit
cases.description: Rule 4: instance count equal to max is within max.

cases.name: max-exceeded
cases.description: Rule 4: more instances than max fails.

cases.name: max-absent-is-unbounded
cases.description: Rule 4: no max means any number of instances.

cases.name: always-missing
cases.description: Rule 5: an always function the request does not ask for rules the circuit out.

cases.name: always-present
cases.description: Rule 5: asking for the always function satisfies it.

cases.name: always-only-request
cases.description: Rule 5: a request for just the always function matches.

cases.name: empty-req
cases.description: Rules 4 and 5: an empty req matches a circuit with no always function and not one with.

cases.name: profile-preferred
cases.description: Ranking: a circuit whose issuance_profile the credential conforms to (or that has none) ranks above one whose issuance_profile it does not conform to.

cases.name: profile-conformant
cases.description: Ranking: with a conforming credential both rank equally and ids decide.

cases.name: profile-before-status
cases.description: Ranking: issuance_profile preference outranks active over deprecated.

cases.name: id-tiebreak
cases.description: Ranking: otherwise equal matches are ordered by id.

cases.name: invalid-request-no-presentation
cases.description: A request without presentation is malformed.

cases.name: invalid-request-no-credential-type
cases.description: A request without credential.type is malformed.

cases.name: issuance-profile-served
cases.description: credential.issuance_profile is a constraint on the input credential, not a filter: a circuit carrying it is served normally.

cases.name: legacy-profile-key-fails-closed
cases.description: The key `profile` was renamed `issuance_profile`; the old key is an unknown member, so the capabilities are rejected and the circuit is not served. expectRejected: the capabilities themselves fail to parse (fail closed), which is why nothing is served.

cases.name: issuance-profile-empty-fails-closed
cases.description: credential.issuance_profile must be a non-empty string: an empty one is rejected and the circuit is not served. expectRejected: the capabilities themselves fail to parse (fail closed), which is why nothing is served.
